name: MMBench-Video
intro: MMBench-Video是一个用于严格评估大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）视频理解能力的定量基准。该基准包含来自YouTube的长视频和自由形式的问题，更贴近实际应用场景，旨在严谨评估模型的视频理解水平。所有问题均由人工根据精心构建的能力分类法进行标注。
org: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, SenseTime Research, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI
build_method: 人工标注, 交叉验证, GPT-4V时序过滤
eval_feature: 长视频理解, 时序推理, GPT-4评审
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Cross-validation, GPT-4V Temporal Filtering
eval_feature_en: Long video understanding, Temporal reasoning, GPT-4 judging
intro_en: MMBench-Video is a quantitative benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate the video understanding capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It includes long videos from YouTube and open-ended questions, reflecting real-world scenarios, and aims to provide a thorough assessment of models' video comprehension. All questions are manually annotated based on a carefully constructed taxonomy of abilities.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[收集16类YouTube长视频] --> B[建立三级26项叶子能力体系]
    B --> C[人工编写自由问答并交叉验证]
    C --> D[四次GPT-4V随机单帧实验]
    D --> E[用GPT-4移除平均分至少2.5的246题]
    E --> F[汇总609个视频与1,998个问答对]
    F --> G[多帧推理并用GPT-4给出0至3分]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect YouTube videos in 16 categories"] --> B["Keep videos at least 30 seconds and QA clips up to six minutes"]
    B --> C["Define a three-level taxonomy with 26 leaf abilities"]
    C --> D["Human-author multiple free-form QA pairs per video"]
    D --> E["Apply five authoring guidelines and cross-validation"]
    E --> F["Run four GPT-4V random-single-frame trials per question"]
    F --> G["Use GPT-4 to remove 246 questions scoring at least 2.5"]
    G --> H["Assemble 609 videos and 1,998 QA pairs"]
    H --> I["Generate model answers from chronological frames and optional subtitles"]
    I --> J["Use GPT-4 semantic judging and report 0-to-3 scores"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集覆盖16类主题的YouTube视频"] --> B["保留至少30秒视频且问答片段不超过六分钟"]
    B --> C["定义含26项叶子能力的三级分类"]
    C --> D["人工为每个视频编写多个自由问答对"]
    D --> E["执行五项编写准则与交叉验证"]
    E --> F["每题运行四次GPT-4V随机单帧实验"]
    F --> G["用GPT-4移除平均分至少2.5的246题"]
    G --> H["汇总609个视频与1,998个问答对"]
    H --> I["根据时序多帧与可选字幕生成模型回答"]
    I --> J["用GPT-4按语义评判并报告零至三分"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.14515 Section 3.1 and Appendices C-D. The diagram preserves 16 YouTube categories, the 30-second minimum and six-minute QA clip bound, the three-level perception/reasoning taxonomy with 26 leaf capabilities, human multi-question authoring and five guidelines, cross-validation, four-seed GPT-4V random-single-frame probing, GPT-4 filtering at mean score 2.5 with 246 questions removed, the final 609 videos and 1,998 QA pairs, chronological multi-frame inference, and GPT-4 semantic grading from 0 to 3.
